versions.name: Sustainability
versions.description: Measure what your household actually consumes in water, food, energy and belongings, then design the fixes: less food waste, a community sketched for lower impact, and habits your family can keep.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
